name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: One section that shows and hides its panel: a quiet text trigger with a turning chevron and a panel that fades in.

manifest.name: collapsible
manifest.title: Collapsible
manifest.description: One section that shows and hides its panel: a quiet text trigger with a turning chevron and a panel that fades in.
manifest.usage: Use Collapsible for one optional block of detail under something else: server notices under a result, advanced connection options, a query plan. Compose Collapsible > CollapsibleTrigger + CollapsiblePanel; control it with open and onOpenChange or start it with defaultOpen. For a list of sections of which one or several open, use Accordion; for detail that only matters on hover, use HoverCard.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger opens or closes it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The trigger does nothing and is dimmed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The section; data-slot="collapsible", data-open when open.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The toggle; data-slot="collapsible-trigger", data-panel-open, aria-expanded, aria-controls.

slots.name: chevron
slots.description: The chevron, turned a quarter while open; data-slot="collapsible-chevron".

slots.name: panel
slots.description: The content; data-slot="collapsible-panel", data-open, data-starting-style and data-ending-style while it fades.

parts.name: CollapsibleTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the panel; chevron={false} drops the chevron.

parts.name: CollapsiblePanel
parts.description: The content shown while open; keepMounted keeps it in the DOM while closed.

states.name: open
states.description: Open: the trigger in color.fg.default and the chevron turned.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the trigger: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The trigger ignores interaction, at opacity.disabled.

states.name: entering
states.description: The panel fades in from opacity 0.

states.name: leaving
states.description: The panel fades out to opacity 0.

accessibility: The trigger is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming the panel; Enter and Space toggle it.
The panel is removed from the DOM (or hidden with keepMounted) while closed, so its content is not read or reached by Tab.
The chevron is aria-hidden; the open state is announced through aria-expanded, not the icon.
Only opacity changes while opening, and the chevron's turn stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
